visualCharacteristics.layout: FILTERS toggle + faceted checkbox panel above a responsive result-card grid, with a Load more button
visualCharacteristics.cardStructure: optional image + content-type label + title + 'Read more' link on a light-grey tile
visualCharacteristics.controls: Filters toggle, Show All (clear), Apply Filter, Load more

contentPattern: Each item: optional image, a text block (content-type label + title + link), and a Facet Tags string categorising it by Content Type / Industries / Capabilities / Partners / Country. The block derives the filter panel from the union of item tags and filters client-side.
usage: 'Find something specific' faceted content/case-study archives (e.g. Merkle Now, Work). Reusable across the site for any authored, checkbox-filtered listing.
